scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.debug: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,widgets -c blue,magenta,cyan "uv run queryview --reload --port ${PORT:-8000}" "npm exec -w frontend -- vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false" "npm exec -w frontend -- vite build -c vite.widgets.config.ts --watch"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e -w frontend && playwright test
